entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hello, Charlie. I need to return an item. I bought a pair of your cycling shoes about two months ago and they just aren't working out for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and the email address on the account?
Of course. It's Alex Smith, and the email is alex.smith@email.com.
Thank you, Alex. I see your order here from 59 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a comfort thing. I've adjusted the cleats every way I can think of, but the cycling shoes are giving me terrible blisters on my heels. I can't ride in them.
I'm very sorry to hear that; that sounds painful and definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, good news. I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.

That's great, thank you. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I did spend two months trying to make them work and ended up with blisters, is there any chance you could add a 10% discount code to my account for a future purchase? I'd like to try a different model.

I understand you're looking for a little something extra for the trouble, and I'm glad we could approve the return. Unfortunately, our system is set up to provide the full refund as the complete resolution in these situations, and I'm not able to issue goodwill credits or discounts on an approved return.
I see. Well, it was worth asking. A full refund is perfectly acceptable. What do I need to do next?

I've just initiated the return process. You will receive an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label. Just package the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives them, your refund will be processed.
Excellent. That's all I needed. Thanks for your help, Charlie.
You are very welcome, Alex. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
